authorities.current: VPS Koios service reached through the existing Cloudflare-proxied koios.news route
authorities.shadow: immutable noindex and advertising-suspended artifact at an exact granted Cloudflare preview deployment
authorities.candidate: production-shaped immutable body manifest held non-authoritatively until its exact delivery policy and cutover act are accepted
authorities.rollbackTarget: retained VPS origin reachable independently of koios.news DNS through the declared operations host and captured origin address

evidenceBinding: Every grant offer receipt parity result mutable-route disposition rollback witness and cutover act names the exact static manifest digest live-publication-witness digest delivery-policy digest Cloudflare account Worker hostname and effect set to which it applies.
A boolean or latest-state reading without those bindings cannot transfer authority.
Candidate body bytes and delivery policy are distinct witnesses: preview may add only the separately digested X-Robots-Tag noindex overlay; authorized cutover removes only that overlay.
phases: freeze and digest the live public-route witness
build and verify the local immutable artifact
settle a credential-free provider packaging rehearsal
receive an exact Cloudflare account and Worker resource grant
upload a non-authoritative noindex shadow preview and prove local-to-preview status header and byte digests
rehearse the exact candidate body bytes under a separately digested preview-only noindex delivery overlay
dispose of every mutable or private route through relocation retirement or separately granted Worker routing
probe the retained VPS origin without using koios.news DNS
rehearse provider-side restoration and cache purge
observe the production route for one accepted window while retaining VPS recovery
retire VPS authority only by a later explicit act

mutableRouteDisposition./healthz: A bounded Worker may answer artifact and deployment health only after its own grant.
mutableRouteDisposition./hit: Requires a separately contracted accountable-attention Worker, or an explicit suspension act paired with an updated privacy surface.
mutableRouteDisposition./views.json: Requires the same accountable-attention service and public aggregate contract as /hit.
mutableRouteDisposition./newsroom: Relocate to a non-public operations hostname before primary-host static cutover; never expose newsroom authority through a static asset.
mutableRouteDisposition./cable: Relocate to a non-public operations hostname or a separately contracted authenticated ingress service.
mutableRouteDisposition./mcp: Relocate to a non-public operations hostname or a separately contracted authenticated protocol boundary.
mutableRouteDisposition./operators: Relocate to a non-public operations hostname; it is not a public static delivery route.

mutableRouteSettlementEvidence: The settlement names the exact candidate manifest, frozen live-publication witness, delivery-policy digest, and candidate privacy artifact.
A safe GET observation records what the still-authoritative live hostname does at each excluded boundary without invoking POST /hit or any operator effect.
The settlement distinguishes the three public application routes from the four separately hosted or reserved private authority boundaries.
Every disposition is effective only under the exact later candidate cutover act; recording it does not mutate the VPS or transfer authority.
Restoring accountable attention requires one separate accepted service that binds both collection and the public aggregate to matching privacy text.

restore the provider route or DNS snapshot that sends koios.news to the retained VPS origin

limits: A local origin reachability rehearsal is not a provider-side rollback rehearsal.
Status and media type equality alone do not prove privacy advertising structured-data correction or security parity.
Production-indexable candidate bytes may not be exposed at a public preview hostname without the accepted preview-only noindex overlay.
No credential configuration preview upload route mutation DNS mutation purge or deployment deletion is authorized by this law alone.
The VPS remains authoritative until all preview and rollback evidence exists and an explicit cutover act transfers authority.
